name: Data on paper: pencil marks, one ramp
for: explainers whose proof is a chart or a number: each mark pops, a ratchet rescales, nothing fades

motion.ease: marks pop in; a ratchet rescales the axis
motion.note: blue pencil for notes, red pencil for records

camera: 2D, the newest mark kept near 60% of the width

sound.mood: pitch follows value; silence before the key mark

source: colour roles, ramp and type sizes after lemo-opuscar's dataviz notes (MIT); surface tint, muted and the display size are ours
